blocks.text: Langley condos and townhomes by price band, September 2026

128 condos and townhomes sold in September against 699 listed. The price band with the most sales was $500,001 to $600,000, with 25 sold (20% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $700,001 to $800,000 at 22%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Bands with nothing listed and nothing sold are left out. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Langley condos and townhomes by bedroom count, September 2026
Splitting September 2026 by size, the most sales came from the 2 bedrooms group, with 56 of 128 sold, against 299 of 699 listed.

faq.a: The Surrey Langley SkyTrain extension ends at Langley City Centre station; all eight stations are under construction and the Province expects the extension to enter operation in late 2029.

faq.q: What should I check before buying a Langley condo?
faq.a: The strata bylaws, the depreciation report, recent strata minutes, the Form B information certificate and the contingency reserve fund — the checklist the live page itself gives — plus, on newer buildings, the exact home-warranty position confirmed from the building's documents.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Langley?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Langley is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
